zones.label: Category A
zones.description: Category A is the closest seating category, giving you the shortest sightline to the stage and the physical details of the performance.

zones.label: Category B
zones.description: Category B is the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot / Our Pick for Tape Face. It keeps you close enough to read the visual comedy clearly while giving you a balanced view of the full stage.

zones.label: Category C
zones.description: Category C is the value option around the outer edges of the room. You still get the full visual-comedy picture while keeping the ticket price lower.
